runs.routine: Escape Room evening push — EXAMPLE crash
runs.banner: LABELED DEMO — fictional timeline inspired by the Oct 8 Escape Room half-finish. Does not read or modify /workspace/tokenmax/escape-room.
runs.summary: Build started clean, scaffolded rooms 1–3, then a headless Chrome screenshot hung, a path typo wrote into the wrong dist folder, and the final zip step aborted. Replay to see exactly where the evening push went sideways.

events.label: google-chrome → #room-4 (hung)
events.detail: Headless Chrome never painted #room-4 — virtual-time-budget exhausted. Puzzle canvas waited on a missing sprite atlas.

events.label: assets/sprites-room4.json (MISSING)
events.detail: app.js referenced /assets/sprites-room4.json but the file was never written. Room 4 froze on boot.

events.label: cp → wrong dist path
events.detail: Typo copied partial HTML into /workspace/tokenmax/camden-nights/dist/ by mistake (sibling project). DEMO only — no real overwrite occurred in this story.

events.label: web/rooms/room4.js (partial)
events.detail: Half-written room module left on disk; no win condition, no exit door wiring.

events.label: ./run.sh --shots
events.detail: Screenshot suite aborted after room-4 timeout; 00-best-home.png never produced.

events.label: zip → TokenMax-escape.zip
events.detail: zip refused incomplete dist/ — exit 12. Evening push stopped; Escape Room deferred to Oct 15.

events.label: run error · deferred to Oct 15
events.detail: Outcome: rooms 1–3 playable, room 4 unfinished, no hero screenshot, no ship zip. Real Escape Room work is scheduled for Thu Oct 15 — this DEMO does not touch that folder.
